title: Privacy Gate
scope: Local deterministic verification of local-first data flow, consent/telemetry opt-in, metadata redaction, retention, sharing, and deletion contracts on the canonical Windows repository.

budgets.metric: creative content (manuskrip/karakter/lore/media) is local-only and never auto-exports; no network upload without explicit user action
budgets.unit: zero auto-upload / auto-scan paths outside package

budgets.metric: telemetry/diagnostics metrics are opt-in, default OFF, deny-by-default on unknown flags
metrics snapshot contains only whitelisted keys (flag, surface, outcome, count); no creative-content fields
share/export sanitization drops internal metadata and applies spoiler redaction before output
budgets.unit: no internal metadata leak in export

budgets.metric: backup retention enforces automatic vs manual budget without cross-eviction
character deletion reviews affected novels and unlink does not delete source; asset unequip deletes only assignment row

baseline.profile: local-first single-user model, media in-package, no auto-upload
automatic vs manual backup retention budget

bottlenecks.impact: Data-flow model is verified by documentation and local tests; runtime network-call instrumentation to prove zero auto-egress in a native journey is not captured.
bottlenecks.next_gate: Capture network egress in a disposable native journey on release-candidate hardware.

bottlenecks.impact: Deletion boundary contracts are proven at test level; the actual user-facing character-delete reviews-affected-novels native dialog is not exercised from cron.
bottlenecks.next_gate: Verify character/story deletion review dialog via computer-use native journey.

findings.summary: No failing privacy finding was produced by the executed local privacy matrix; telemetry is opt-in default OFF with metadata-only whitelist; exports are sanitized.

remediations.summary: PrivacySafeMetrics increments are silently dropped until optIn is set; unknown flags and unknown outcomes are denied by default.
Snapshot keys are exactly {flag, surface, outcome, count}; no creative-content fields are ever recorded.

residual_risk_acceptance.acceptance: Runtime network-egress instrumentation and native deletion-journey verification deferred to release-candidate operational validation per permission_privacy_model.md PM4.

limits: Runtime network egress is not instrumented in this local test gate; the data-flow model is documented and tested at contract level.
Native GUI, hosted CI, signing, hardware, and public release remain UNVERIFIABLE and belong to dedicated later gates.
This decision is not a production privacy certification.
